buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Important Notes: 1. Bidders are required to quote “Total Hiring Charges for 36 months” inclusi ve of GST for Sl. No. 01 & 02 given in the ITB. Total price inclusive of GST is t o be quoted for all the line items of the bid. 2. Only Single GST percentage (5% or 18% based on the organization status of the bidder as per GST provisions) for the entire line items (Sl. No. 1 to 8 given in the ITB) shall be allowed in this contract. 3. The bid is created considering 5% GST for all line items including those having minimum allowed bidding value (Sl. No. 3 to 8 given in the ITB). Bidder(s) opting for 18% GST should ensure that the quoted price/value is increased proportionat ely considering the opted 18% GST for Sl. No. 3 to 8 given in the ITB. 4. If the bidder opts for 18% GST and after price bid opening if it is found that the quoted price for line items with minimum allowed bidding value (Sl. No. 3 to 8 gi ven in the ITB) are not quoted considering the opted 18% GST, then the quoted V ehicle Hiring Charges (Sl. No. 1 to 2 given in the ITB) shall be reduced proportion ately to match the higher value/amount corresponding to the GST percentage of 18% opted by the bidder for evaluation and ordering purpose. Important Note: The total ordering value shall not exceed the total price quoted in GeM portal in any case. 5. The total price including GST quoted in GeM portal shall be considered for eval uation and ordering as per provisions detailed in Para 4 above. 6. Prices quoted above the minimum allowed bidding value (subject to provisions mentioned at Para 3 and 4 above) mentioned in GEM portal for Item Sl. No. 3 to 8 given in the ITB shall be summed up and added to Sl. No. 01 & 02 given in the ITB for evaluation and ordering. This amount shall be considered as part of Sl. No . 1 & 2 given in the ITB and paid on prorata basis monthly as per the provisions defined in ITB for Sl. No. 1 & 2 given in the ITB. 7. The apportionment of value/amount for the reduction/increase in Hiring charges for Sl. No. 1 and 2 given in the ITB based on the scenarios detailed at Para 3, 4 a nd 6 shall be in the ratio 4:1. 8. The estimated rate for Sl. No. 3 to 8 given in the ITB includes sufficient margin t owards overheads i.e. minimum infrastructure to be maintained by the bidder fo r execution of the contract, running office expenses, coordination with Statutory

Authorities, charges towards Bank Guarantees (BG), interest on working capital, documentation charge and reasonable profit margin. 9. Contractor have to pay overtime charges and wage revision, if any. Provision w ill be made in contract (LOA) to reimburse the same. Bidder need not to conside r these components while quoting. 10. The reimbursement due to any upward revision of wages shall be limited only t o the statutory wage components i.e. Wages, PF, ESI / EC, Bonus and Leave wag es and the impact of revision on wages shall not be allowed on overheads considered in the estimate. . 2.
